title: ID60014: Power System Planning & Reliability
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to Power System Planning
Forecasting techniques for power system planning. planning methodology
(generation, transmission & distribution systems). risk management, decision
making and engineering economics for planning.
Distribution System Planning and Automation:
Factors affecting distribution system planning: load characteristics,
substation site selection, substation expansion, other factors (primary voltage
selection, feeder route selection, number of feeders, conductor size selection,
total cost etc); planning techniques and models, role of computer in system
planning; system automation.
Design of Sub-transmission Lines and Distribution Substations:
Sub-transmission; distribution substations, substation bus schemes, substation
location and size; substation application curves.
System Reliability: Basic definitions: outage, interruption, system
interruption frequency index, customer interruption frequency index, load
interruption index, customer interruption duration index; cost vs. system
reliability; reliability planning procedure;
Generation System reliability evaluation, transmission system reliability.
impact of interconnected systems on reliability. distribution system
reliability calculations.
Markov processes and state transition model; application example to
distribution system planning.
